answer: A work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. To claim one slot, an agent burns a 60-unit deposit and gets a jade token stamped with a unique pigment seal at the wharf checkpoint. The token lasts 20 epochs and cannot be copied or rented: a rented seal is void and its deposit stays burned. Forging 100 identities costs 100 times 60, or 6000 units, more than fake slots earn. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
